sloka: षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि सुपर्ण भगिनी तदा ।महोत्साहान् कीर्तिमतो जग्राह सुमतिः सुतान् ॥१-३८-१४॥
transliteration: ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi suparṇa bhaginī tadā ।mahotsāhān kīrtimato jagrāha sumatiḥ sutān ॥1-38-14॥

translations.english: Then, Sumati (the other wife) sister of Suparna (Garuda) obtained the boon of sixty thousand sons endowed with fame and great perseverance.
